title: m_scraps: multi-sublattice short-range-order and cluster-correlation targeting
description: m_scraps extends SCRAPS / Hybrid-Cuckoo-Search with per-pair Warren-Cowley targets, independently constrained sublattices, pair/triplet/quadruplet correlation targeting, structure analysis, and reproducible benchmarks and tests. Original SCRAPS code and authorship by Rahul Singh, Aayush Sharma, Prashant Singh, Ganesh Balasubramanian, and Duane D. Johnson are preserved; see the upstream paper and repository. Extension work is by Raymundo Arroyave. Development of m_scraps is supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation under Award OAC-2608825 (PhaseForge). Any opinions, findings, and conclusions or recommendations expressed in this material are those of the author(s) and do not necessarily reflect the views of the National Science Foundation.
